But that's because I've gotten re-involved in [Haven and Hearth](http://www.havenandhearth.com/portal/). This game is a sandbox survival MMO (similar to Wurm Online, which I, admittedly, never played), in which one must survive this Slavic and German mythology inspired world. What I like about the game so much is it's slow grind, that requires the player to accomplish many smaller tasks in order to achieve something worthwhile. This gives me a great sense of satisfaction whenever I accomplish anything that required hours of gathering and crafting.

What I'm here to do is offer a nice jumping off point for those who want to join this Free-to-Play game. By this, I mean I will have your new character spawn near my character's home, where I will be able to help you advance through the game at a much quicker rate than a new, lone spruce cap ever could. I do this not only to help new players, but to form a community of players able to protect each other from the (non-NPC) raiders that roam the game.

Now I will concede, this game does run like ass, and doesn't even look all that great, even after it's recent transition into 3D. Plus the UI isn't all that great so one would have to download a client just for the game to be easily playable, such as [Amber Client](http://www.havenandhearth.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=49&t=40400&hilit=linux) right here. But I've been able to ignore all these problems both back when I played it two years ago and when I play it now. I think, in the end that the game is good enough and has enough community fixes that it is worth playing as of right now.

So, for those who want to join, here is how you join and spawn near my in game home:

* Register for the game at the website [here](http://www.havenandhearth.com/portal/register). For those who are wondering, them game is free-to-play, with subscribers getting a 30% learning points bonus and a 100% speed increase when doing certain actions. * Before creating your first character, reply to this post with your interest in playing so that I may light up a wilderness beacon, which is the teleportation device that will transport you to my house. * When following the instructions to create your first character, instead of "burning in the fire" to complete the procedure, go past the fire on the ground, and right-click on the deer skull on a stick. * Once you've right-clicked on the deer skull, a box will appear, and ask you to enter a name. Hope to see someone soon.
